description: Discrepancies and undocumented details in the cited Learn pages, SDK revision, and scoped live Azure recordings. This ledger does not certify Azuifer parity.

entries.summary: List XML ETags are unquoted; HTTP ETags use quotes.
entries.expected_by_docs_or_sdk: List Blobs gives an <Etag> placeholder without specifying quotation; Get Blob explicitly specifies quoted HTTP ETags for versions 2011-08-18 and later.
entries.observed_behavior: The live list_first and list_nested exchanges record etag=unquoted_match. Do not apply the HTTP quotation rule to the XML field.

evidence.detail: Response body (XML): <Etag>etag</Etag> does not specify quotation.
Response headers: HTTP ETag values are quoted from version 2011-08-18.
status=200; body.entries[0].etag=unquoted_match. Recording inspected on the unmerged cassette branch.

entries.summary: Both checksum headers produce the specific BothCrc64AndMd5RangeHeaderPresent error.
entries.expected_by_docs_or_sdk: Get Blob documents HTTP 400 when both checksum headers are supplied, but does not name the error code; the cited Blob error table also omits it.
entries.observed_behavior: HTTP 400 with BothCrc64AndMd5RangeHeaderPresent in the error header and XML body. The status agrees with the docs.

evidence.detail: x-ms-range-get-content-crc64 documents the both-headers HTTP 400 case.
The error table does not list BothCrc64AndMd5RangeHeaderPresent.
status=400; error_header and body.code=both_crc64_and_md5_range_header_present. Recording inspected on the unmerged cassette branch.

entries.expected_by_docs_or_sdk: The conditional-header page specifies HTTP 304 but not the x-ms-error-code header on that response.
entries.observed_behavior: HEAD and GET not-modified exchanges have status=304, error_header=condition_not_met, and an empty body.

evidence.detail: The read-condition tables specify 304 without the corresponding error header.
status=304; error_header=condition_not_met; body.kind=empty. get_not_modified and mixed_not_modified agree. Recording inspected on the unmerged cassette branch.

entries.operation: Create Hard Link / Create Symbolic Link
entries.summary: Learn lists x-ms-file-file-id; the Python SDK reads x-ms-file-id.
entries.expected_by_docs_or_sdk: The Learn response-header tables name x-ms-file-file-id.
entries.observed_behavior: The generated Python SDK deserializes x-ms-file-id for both operations. Live NFS behavior has not been established.

evidence.detail: create_symbolic_link and create_hard_link parse x-ms-file-id at lines 3664 and 3853.

entries.summary: The Read Symbolic Link page disagrees with itself about the first supported API version.
entries.observed_behavior: The x-ms-version request-header row says 2025-05-05 and later. The correct live boundary needs recording.

observations.summary: Echoed continuation markers are documented behavior, not an Azure discrepancy.
observations.expected_by_docs_or_sdk: The response-body section says Marker is present when specified on the request URI.
observations.observed_behavior: The live list_next exchange has echoed_marker=matches. The earlier omission was in Azuifer, not Learn.

evidence.detail: Response body (XML) explicitly describes Marker echo.
status=200; body.echoed_marker=matches. Recording inspected on the unmerged cassette branch.

observations.summary: The earlier Get Symbolic Link versus Read Symbolic Link claim is not substantiated by the cited Learn pages.
observations.expected_by_docs_or_sdk: An earlier note referred to Get Symbolic Link.
observations.observed_behavior: Both the operation index and reference page say Read Symbolic Link; the request is GET ?restype=symboliclink. A second authoritative naming source is still needed.

evidence.detail: The index names Read Symbolic Link.
The reference title also names Read Symbolic Link.
